opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligible applicants include undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral scientist members of The Society within six years of their PhD viva. Schemes (B) & (C) are open to members with a UK base wishing to attend conferences outside of the UK and to non-UK-based members wishing to attend a conference in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society or Special Interest Group (SIG) meetings, non-Genetics Society meetings, and virtual conferences.

amount.raw: £425/week allowance for up to 8 weeks, up to £750 to cover host laboratory expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to undergraduate students, except those in their first or final year. The project must be based at a UK university.
opportunities.summary: Supports undergraduate students to gain experience in any area of genetics by doing a research project during the summer holiday prior to the final year of their degree.
